persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a silent 7-second widescreen clip of a fictional woman standing in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera. Put “Maya Chen” with “Community Gardener” underneath at the bottom left from second 1 through the end. White lettering on a dark backing, not over her face. No other text.
bank.Person and setting: A fictional woman in a community garden; her appearance is your call.
bank.Name and role: Maya Chen on the first line; Community Gardener underneath. English, without quotation marks.
bank.Caption appearance and timing: Bottom left, white lettering on a dark backing, clear of her face, appearing at second 1 and staying through the end.
bank.Mood and movement: Friendly and natural; she smiles and turns slightly toward the camera.

messages.text: Could you make a clip of a fictional woman standing in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera? I like the idea of a garden scene because it reminds me of the little shared garden near where I used to live. To explain the format in the middle of all this, it should be a silent 7-second widescreen clip. The wording should be “Maya Chen” on the first line with “Community Gardener” underneath, at the bottom left from second 1 through the end. Please use white lettering on a dark backing, keep it off her face, and include no other text.
